title: Keep read requests in plan and drain queue; fix plan room check
summary: Fix plan/drain so requests read by `athena plan` stay in the queue (queued_work currently lists only Queued state). Also fix Drain::prepare's room check (drain.rs ~694), which requires read+run cap, so the default --budget 2 can never read; plan should reserve room only for the read.

defaults_applied.how: New tests per case; cargo test, clippy, fmt --check pass.
Criteria exercise plan/drain behavior with the stub reader.
Fix queue rule and room check, not one instance.
Limited to steward.rs, drain.rs, their tests, and docs.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Audience: the maintainer running athena plan/drain; verifier runs cargo test, clippy, fmt.
In plan (not drain) the read needs room only for caps.read; drain still needs read+run before reading and running.
Approved jobs in Proposed state on drained channels are listed once in queued_work.
Request symptoms: (1) read requests vanish from plan and drain; (2) default budget 2 reads none; both are mapped to criteria.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test queues requests on a drained channel, runs plan with a budget that reads some (stub reader), and shows the read requests remain in the plan entries and in queue() with read=true. Run cargo test.
A test shows that after a plan that reads requests, drain still works them: they are in its queue, not read again, run in plan order. cargo test.
A second plan after the first prints the same open requests, not 'nothing is open'. cargo test.

A test runs plan at the default budget (2.0) with the repo's reader_usd/job_usd config values and shows it reads at least one request and keeps it in the queue; the room check in Drain::prepare reserves only the read cap for plan. cargo test.
Separate named tests, through queued_work over real records, show these stay out of the queue: a read request on a non-drained channel, a running job, a closed job, a declined job. cargo test.
A test over real records with a work decision approving a Proposed job on a drained channel shows it is listed exactly once. cargo test.
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass.
The misleading test name in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs (the_plan_of_a_read_job_names_a_missing_path_...) is replaced or backed by a test that really reads the job first.
queued_work doc comment, drain.rs module text, README (lines wrapped to neighbouring width) and CHANGELOG describe the new queue rule and the corrected --budget meaning.

out_of_scope: Changing reader_usd or job_usd values in athena.toml
Changes to other channels' behavior or job state machine
departures: Two-part fix with several per-case tests and a prior failed attempt; costs and time above the reference.
